observations: A yellow manual hydraulic pallet jack sits on an outdoor tiled porch.
Two forks are visible, each with a small white rectangular label near the wheel housing, but the text is too small/blurry to read reliably.
Visible surface rust and paint wear on the frame and forks.
Handle/mast assembly appears intact, no visible cracks.
Background shows unrelated items (a wheelchair, bags) and a watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77' overlaid on the image.
No photo shows the jack lifting a load, no close-up of the capacity plate, and no clear shot of the wheels or fork tips.

claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a small label on the fork but the capacity number is not legible; no clear plate shot provided.

claims.claim: Implied working hydraulic lift function (from 'Upgrade your warehouse...' marketing text)
claims.evidence: No video or photo showing the forks raised or under load.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may be weak, leaking, or non-functional
risks.proof: Short video of the handle being pumped and forks visibly rising, ideally under a loaded pallet

risks.risk: Stated 2.5 Ton capacity cannot be confirmed from the blurry label
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the capacity plate/label on the fork showing legible rating
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard/lower-capacity (e.g. 2 ton or unverified) unit rather than the claimed 2.5 ton

risks.risk: Wheel condition (flat spots, cracked polyurethane, bearing wear) affects usability and price
risks.proof: Close-up photo of all four wheels from the side
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn wheels needing replacement

risks.risk: Fork alignment or bending from heavy use, not visible at this angle
risks.proof: Straight-on photo from the fork tips showing both forks level and parallel

risks.risk: Extent of rust/corrosion may indicate structural weakness or long outdoor storage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame joints, axle, and pump housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-to-moderate corrosion, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the capacity plate/label on the fork
Short video of the pump handle being operated showing the forks rising and lowering, ideally under a loaded pallet
Close-up photos of all four wheels
Side-on photo showing fork straightness and the pump/hydraulic cylinder for leaks
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a manual hydraulic pallet jack, but the capacity claim and working condition are unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified capacity, assumed non-functional lift, visible rust) pending the requested proof.
